children: TotalEnergies CEO Patrick Pouyanne doesn't see a physical gas supply risk in Europe but says the continent will have to compete with Asia for LNG cargos, which could further support prices. The company's integrated gas business continues to benefit from rising gas prices and low European inventories, Barclays analyst Lydia Rainforth writes after hosting Pouyanne at the Barclays Energy-Power Conference. Pouyanne's outlook for oil is more uncertain, she writes. It is unclear whether the drop in Chinese demand since the start of the conflict reflectsstructural demand changes or temporary demand destruction, she writes.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
